name: Mailbox_Main
evidence: Mailbox screen ('メールボックス', 12 records in SRAM bank0 A124+n*$12D): list of 4 rows, read/reply/delete icons; C264=0 normal, $FF = choose-mail-to-delete mode; far-called from 7C:7C61, 7C:7CC4, 27:4173; executed in mail_inbox/mail_mailbox

name: Mailbox_Main_Loop
evidence: per-frame loop head of Mailbox_Main: sprites 00:0956, wait, joypad 7D:7BB7, then Mailbox_CountRecords; B leaves (returns A=$FF), A opens the icon menu, up/down move (Mailbox_CursorUp/Down)

name: Mailbox_IconMenu_Loop
evidence: loop head after A on a mail: left/right ($20/$10) move the icon cursor D (0 read, 1 reply, 2 delete) via Mailbox_SetActionCursor, A executes (25:420A), B returns to the list

name: Mailbox_IconMenu_PressA
evidence: A pressed on the icon cursor D: D==2 -> delete confirmation (dialog 72:4015 id $0206, then record delete 2D:4133 and Mailbox_RedrawAfterDelete), else jp 25:446E (reply/read); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_IconMenu_ReplyOrRead
evidence: icon D==1 (reply, at 25:4490) or D==0 (read, jp 25:465C); in C264=$FF mode the icon menu is bypassed; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_ReplyStart
evidence: reply when the outbox area ([A000] bank0) is empty: bank-04 request 00:20AC id $2C, hides sprites, Mailbox_ReplyToRecord (54A7) and restores the list; if [A000] != 0 a dialog id $0213 is shown instead (25:44AC); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_ReadMail
evidence: icon D==0: if record+1 flag is set clears it and shows dialog $021E/$022B (22:501D), then opens the mail viewer 2B:6482 with the record index (B+C); returns to the list; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_SetActionCursor
evidence: D=icon 0-2: object 26:7B10/7B20/7B30 in sprite slot DA20 at y=$70, x=$20/$48/$70 and hint text Mailbox_ShowHint(D) + upload; the read/reply/delete icon cursor; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_CursorUp
evidence: Up pressed ($40 repeat): moves the list cursor C up (scrolls offset B when at the top of the 4 visible rows, wraps to the last mail), redraws sender/timestamp/rows/numbers/icons; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_CursorDown
evidence: Down pressed ($80 repeat): moves the list cursor C down (scrolls B, stops at the last used record via Mailbox_NextRecordUsed), redraws like Mailbox_CursorUp; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_UpdateScrollArrows
evidence: Shows the up/down scroll arrow sprites (objects 26:7B40/7B50, slots DA30/DA40) when more than 4 mails exist, else parks them off screen at x=$D0; twin of 25:4D99; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_NextRecordUsed
evidence: B=scroll,C=cursor: A = first byte (in-use flag) of record B+C+1 in SRAM bank0, or 0 if that index is 12; used by Mailbox_CursorDown; executed

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_4A15
evidence: 12 words $A124+n*$12D = addresses of the 12 mail records (SRAM bank0); indexed 2*(B+C) at 25:4687/4A0B; identical copies at 4AF5/4E2B/4F28/50AA/5228/5569/5871

name: Mailbox_RedrawAfterDelete
evidence: After a mail was deleted (2D:4133): adjusts scroll B/cursor C and redraws sender name, row titles, tiles, numbers, icons, timestamp; single caller 25:42FF; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_ShowEmptyList
evidence: Clears WRAM2 $D000 x$0D00 text tile buffer, redraws timestamp and tile upload and resets sprites: the display when no mail is left (25:4341 after count==0); not executed in traces

name: Mailbox_CountRecords
evidence: SRAM bank0: D = number of consecutive used records (first byte != 0) from A124, stride $12D, 0-12; leaves SRAM enabled; used by 25/26/27/29/7C (12 = mailbox full); executed in 15 scenarios

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_4AF5
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table (A124+n*$12D); no direct ld hl,$4AF5 found

name: Mailbox_LoadScreen
evidence: Loads the mailbox screen: sprite reset, 2D:4E06, palettes 69B0/6EF0, tiles 5A10/5E10/69F0/6A00/6CF0 (5F10/6310 + tilemap 66E0 in delete mode C264=$FF), tilemap 6410, count/row attributes; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_UpdateScrollArrows_B
evidence: identical twin of Mailbox_UpdateScrollArrows (25:4987), called only from Mailbox_LoadScreen (25:4D27)

name: Mailbox_DrawSenderName
evidence: B+C=record: draws the 16-byte name field (record+$C9, default 'マリオ') with Mailbox_DrawTextLine at y=$02,x=$30 (the 'ニックネーム' box of the rendered screen); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_4E2B
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table; read at 25:4E13 (sender name field)

name: Mailbox_DrawRowTitles
evidence: Draws the 20-byte text field (record+$D9, default 'またあそぼうね') of the 4 visible records at rows y=$10/$1C/$28/$34, x=$20 (highlights row C); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_4F28
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table; read at 25:4E67/4EA0/4ED9/4F12 (row titles)

name: Mailbox_DrawTimestamp
evidence: Record+3..+8 (6 BCD bytes 20 00 06 28 12 30 in the default records) -> 12 digit tiles ($D0+nibble) at VRAM $98A1.. with gaps for the 年 月 日 時 分 labels; also into WRAM7 map; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_50AA
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table; read at 25:4F48 (timestamp)

name: Mailbox_ClearTimestamp
evidence: Same as Mailbox_DrawTimestamp but writes only blank tile $D0 for all 12 digit cells (used when no mail is selected / list empty); executed in 5 scenarios

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_5228
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table; first entry read by 25:50CA (Mailbox_ClearTimestamp)

name: Mailbox_DrawTextLine
evidence: HL=NUL-terminated SJIS/ASCII text in SRAM bank0, A=max cells, DE=y,x: 7F:41A7 (2-byte test), 7F:405F/4007 (glyph), 7F:42C3 (blit), x+=6, blank padding; sibling of 24:494C and 28:41CB (same loop, not byte-identical); executed

name: Mailbox_BlitGlyphAdvance
evidence: Blits glyph buffer $C0A0 via 7F:42C3 at the text position and advances x by 6; helper of Mailbox_DrawTextLine; executed

name: Mailbox_DrawMailCount
evidence: Shows the number of mails (Mailbox_CountRecords, 0-12) as two digit tiles ($E0+digit) at VRAM $98CE and WRAM7 $D0CE (the 'NN/12' counter of the screen); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_UploadTextTiles
evidence: Copies the text tile buffers of WRAM bank2 (D000,D400,D800,DC00) to VRAM $9000/$9400/$8800/$8C00 via Gfx_StartHDMAAtVBlank (25:538A); executed in 5 scenarios

name: Gfx_StartHDMAAtVBlank
evidence: HL=source, DE=VRAM dest, C=blocks-1: rHDMA1-4 set, wait LY=$8F then LY=$91, rHDMA5=C&$7F (general purpose HDMA); library used by 22:48B3/48C1, 23:47A2/47B0, 2B:47C2, 2C:66F4 and this bank; executed in 12 scenarios

name: Mailbox_ShowHint
evidence: D=-1..3 (message D+1 of table 25:53D0): renders the 20-cell hint text into WRAM2 $DA00/$DB40 via 48:403E (select mail / read / reply / delete / no mail); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_HintTable
evidence: 5 words -> the five hint strings 25:53DA/5403/542C/5455/547E; read by 25:53B2 (ld hl,$53D0)

name: Mailbox_Hint_SelectMail
evidence: 'メールを せんたくしてください' = select a mail (hint index 0, shown in the delete-selection mode)

name: Mailbox_Hint_Read
evidence: 'もらったメールを よみます' = read the received mail (hint for icon 0)

name: Mailbox_Hint_Reply
evidence: 'このメールに へんじをかきます' = write a reply to this mail (hint for icon 1)

name: Mailbox_Hint_Delete
evidence: 'このメールを けします' = delete this mail (hint for icon 2)

name: Mailbox_Hint_NoMail
evidence: 'メールが ありません' = there is no mail (hint index 4, shown when the mailbox is empty)

name: Mailbox_ReplyToRecord
evidence: Reply: clears WRAM1 $D400 x$124, copies record+$ED (40 B ASCII address) to $D4C0 and record+$C9 (16 B name) to $D514, sets $D524=3/index, then farcalls 2D:65B0, 2C:4000, 2D:4722; A=$FF if cancelled

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_5569
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table; read at 25:54E2 (reply)

name: Mailbox_ShowRowNumbers
evidence: B=scroll: copies 4 number tiles VRAM $8700+16*B -> $8010, parks the 4 row-number sprites (DA50-DA80) then shows as many as there are mails (objects 26:7B60-7B90 = digits 1-4 at y=$38/$44/$50/$5C); executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_ShowRowStatusIcons
evidence: Shows one envelope sprite per visible mail (slots DA90-DAC0; object 26:7BB0 open envelope, or 26:7BA0 closed when Function_25_5848 returns $FF) and the cursor-row variants 26:7BC0/7BD0; executed in mail_inbox

name: Function_25_5848
evidence: A+B=record index: returns $FF if record byte0 == 1 else 0; selects the closed-envelope object; idea: byte0==1 marks an unread/new mail (default records hold 01)

name: Mailbox_RecordAddrs_5871
evidence: copy of the 12-word mail record address table; read at 25:585C (Function_25_5848)

name: Mailbox_SetIconBarAttrs
evidence: A=0..2: copies two 20-byte BG attribute rows of 25:58ED/591D/594D to VRAM bank1 $99C0/$99E0 (and WRAM7 $D5C0/$D5E0), i.e. the palette/enable state of the three-icon bar; executed in mail_inbox

name: Mailbox_IconBarAttrTable
evidence: 3 words -> the 48-byte attribute blocks 25:58ED/591D/594D (2 rows x 24 B, 20 used); read by 25:5891

name: Mailbox_IconBarAttrs
evidence: 12 rows x 24 B of BG attributes ($09/$0B/$0C/$29); copied 20 bytes per row by Mailbox_SetIconBarAttrs
